个人资料与通用记忆分别保存。知识图谱展示来源和关系，可以旋转、平移、缩放与打开来: Save personal sources and general memory separately. Use the graph to explore relationships, orbit, pan, zoom and open sources.
先添加并验证供应商连接，再选择文本、视觉与索引能力的默认来源。: Add and verify a provider connection, then choose defaults for text, vision and indexing.
账户启停、会员资格、平台额度分别管理。调整前核对对象、有效期和原因。: Manage account status, memberships and credits separately. Confirm the user, validity period and reason before making changes.
执行失败可按原因重试；结果未知先核实是否已保存。不要把空白结果标为待确认。: Retry failures after reviewing their cause. Verify whether unknown results were saved first. Empty results must not be marked for confirmation.
先检查备份范围与记录，再在明确影响的操作页中执行恢复。: Review backup scope and history, then perform a restore in an operation view that explains its impact.
平台审核通过后仍需项目授权。未知工具与扩大后的读取范围需要重新核对。: Platform approval still requires project authorization. New tools or expanded scope need another review.
日志中不展示密码、令牌或 API Key。: Logs do not expose passwords, tokens or API keys.
按项目显式选择平台或个人模型: Choose platform or personal models per project
显示原因，避免把空结果标为成功: Show the reason; do not treat an empty result as success
凭据加密保存，不回显明文: Encrypted credentials, never displayed in plaintext

连接响应超时 · 不含项目内容: Connection timed out · No project content
失败、成功与结果未知分别处理。结果未知的任务需要核实后再决定是否重试。: Treat failures, successes and unknown results separately. Verify unknown results before deciding to retry.
达到阈值暂停主动探测: Pause active probes at the threshold
超时后按策略重新验证: Reverify after expiry according to policy
先核对签名与模板，再用明确的目标号码测试。: Review the signature and template, then test with a specific recipient.
供应商接受请求与用户收到短信属于不同状态。原型不发送真实短信。: Provider acceptance and message delivery are different states. The prototype sends no SMS.
账户状态、会员资格与资源授权独立判断。: Account status, membership and resource access are evaluated separately.
资格失效后按当前规则限制个人模型等受限能力，既有项目资料和操作记录保留。: Expired membership limits restricted capabilities such as personal models. Existing project sources and operation records are retained.

林予邀请你加入团队，接受后可以访问已授权项目。: Lin invited you to this team. Accept to open authorized projects.

此资料尚无明确关联的项目事实。: No project facts explicitly reference this source.
只有你明确标记的约定会用于你发起的项目 AI 请求；项目约定优先，项目成员可能在: Only conventions you explicitly mark are used in project AI requests you initiate. Project rules take priority; team members may see them in generated content.
快速查资料、理清思路，回答保留引用来源。: Find answers and clarify ideas, with sources for every answer.
